title: E3 Workspace UI: no overlapping run-details polls
description: trace-ui/src/WebApp.tsx:146-150 (served UI branch fix/hosted-signed-login-only and develop) re-sends the DETAILS graphql every second with setInterval and never waits for the previous response; at 15 s/request ~15 pile up. Change: self-scheduling loop that waits for the previous response, 3-5 s interval, pauses when the tab is hidden, backs off on errors/503. Also fold eventCursor into the details query, load {cyclotrons} lazily, skip cyclotronVersions when the run has none. Acceptance: spec 'does not start another details request while one is in flight' and 'pauses while hidden'. Deploy note: the live lab front end (CloudFront d1rab2h8u5j1hk, files last updated 2026-10-16) is built from the unmerged fix/hosted-signed-login-only line and is not in cyclotron-production; its deploy path must be found (likely the anthus account) before this can ship.
